Full-Print vs Screen Print

Why Full-Print Wins

Full-print (sublimation) fuses ink into the fabric itself — so your design stays as sharp as day one.

OUR CHOICE
Fullprint

Full-Print

Sublimation printing
  • ✓Unlimited colors, gradients and patterns — edge to edge
  • ✓Ink bonds with the fabric: won't crack, peel or fade easily
  • ✓Light and breathable — no heavy layer on the shirt
  • ✓Names, numbers and sponsor logos printed in one go
Sablon

Screen Print

Ink layered on top
  • –Limited number of colors per design
  • –Print sits on the surface and can crack over time
  • –Thicker print areas feel heavier and less breathable
  • –Complex full-body artwork is hard to achieve
